name: cavalry-default
_doc: 총기병 (default cavalry): WWI mounted rifleman on a bay horse. Shared infantry body: field-grey stand-collar tunic, khaki breeches, tall riding boots, Feldkappe (team band) + arm patch. Carbine (saddle boot, horse's right) and sabre (saddle scabbard, horse's left). Frame 192x224, anchor (96,190) = ground under the horse's centre. No dismount.
